requirements.title: Required Courses
requirements.sourceText: The following courses (12 credits) are required of minors - JRN 101 - News Literacy 3 credits - COM 106 - Introduction to Mass Media 3 credits - JRN 116 - Introduction to Digital Journalism 3 credits - COM 208 - Mass Communication 3 credits

requirements.title: Electives

rule.manualCheck: The page refers to the course offerings listed under the Journalism, BA program for the elective options. Confirm that each elective is a journalism course at the 300 level or above, and that the student has U3/U4 standing to enroll.

requirements.sourceText: Three journalism electives (9 credits) at or above the 300 level are required. Please check the course offering from the Journalism, BA program for options. Electives require U3/U4 standing to enroll.

policies.sourceText: Students must earn a letter grade of C or higher in all journalism courses and Satisfactory or S in JRN internships, independent studies and workshops for these to count toward the minor.

notes.text: JRN internships, independent studies and workshops count toward the minor only with a grade of Satisfactory or S. Journalism courses require a letter grade of C or higher.
Minors are welcome to take additional journalism courses, but should consult with the Undergraduate Director.
Transfer courses will be evaluated individually for journalism equivalency by the Undergraduate Director.
Advising is available through SoCJ Undergraduate Advising (socjadvising@stonybrook.edu, (631) 632-7403).
